extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners; patent attorneys and applicants interacting with EPO procedure
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive Guidelines for Examination at the European Patent Office covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition/limitation, procedural matters, patentability criteria and amendment rules for European patent applications and patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory guidance and overarching principles for applying the Guidelines for Examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets scope, purpose and general application of the Guidelines; explains relationship to law and practice and how EPO staff should use the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes clarifying structure, terminology and cross-references used in the Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides overview and abbreviations, and explains how to interpret and navigate the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level remarks on application of the EPC and examination practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines principles of procedure, examiner responsibilities and interaction with applicants; frames the more detailed chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on organisational and operational aspects of EPO examination work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers division of labour, roles, internal procedures and quality control relevant to conducting searches and examinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Survey of the processing of applications and patents at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the lifecycle and stages of processing European patent applications and granted patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps filing, search, substantive examination, grant, publication, opposition, limitation/revocation and post‑grant steps; used for procedural planning and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting States to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: List and status of Contracting States and implications for European patent procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains territorial scope and specific effects on procedure, validation, national requirements and translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension to states not party to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and procedures for extension of European patent effects to non‑Contracting States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes extension agreements and applicable practical steps for applicants and examiners when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedure when an application is filed and the initial filing examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies formal filing requirements, content checks on filing, filing date allocation, and immediate checks an office must perform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures to assess whether an application meets formal requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on checking documents, signatures, representation, fee payment, sequence of formal objections and how to invite corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special rules and exceptions that affect filing or formalities examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May cover priority documents, provisional applications, divisional filings, secrecy, or other non‑standard cases and how to handle them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicating the formalities report; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How to issue formalities reports, invite/amend applications and correct errors in filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural steps for communicating defects, time limits for replying, accepted corrections and standards for allowing corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for publication of applications, requesting substantive examination and transferring files to examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timings, formalities, consequences of non‑request, and practical guidance on dossier transmission and completeness checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements and procedures in application and proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies filing language, translation requirements, language of proceedings, and derogations/exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions common to various formalities matters and cross‑cutting rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General rules applied across multiple procedural chapters (e.g., time limits, notifications, representation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for drawings in patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for quality, scale, legends, reference signs, amendments to drawings and how drawings are examined and reproduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on fee types, payment timing, and consequences of non‑payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes filing, search, designation, examination and renewal fees; rules for refunds, missing payments and restoration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the Register of European Patents; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and rights concerning public inspection, access to file contents, Register consultation and certified copies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains who may inspect, how to request copies, confidentiality limits and formalities for certified documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction (Part B – Search)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory principles for search practice at the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets search objectives, scope and legal basis for search; frames the following search chapters.

rubrics_metrics.name: General (Search)
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles and responsibilities when performing searches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers examiner duties, search strategy planning and relationship between search and later examination stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards describing what a proper search must achieve and the qualities of a good search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Likely includes completeness, relevance, reproducibility, documentation, and standards for including citations in the search report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Stepwise procedure and tactics for carrying out the prior art search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on class searches, keyword strategies, databases, documenting search queries and prioritising relevant fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification (routing) and official classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: How applications are routed and classified prior to and during search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes practical criteria for IPC/CPC classification, preclassification tools and effects on search workload.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and assessment of the state of the art as relevant for search reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what constitutes prior art for search purposes, cut‑off dates and treatment of different documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity for purposes of search and how lack of unity is handled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria to decide whether inventions belong to a single general inventive concept; approach to partial searches and additional search fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject‑matter that are not to be searched by the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E.g., non‑patentable subject‑matter or items outside EPO competence and how examiners should document exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: What must be recorded about the search: sources, strategy, and results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for documenting search process, citations found, relevance ranking and reproducibility of the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, content and legal effect of the EPO search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes contents (citations, categories), formal layout, timing and how applicants are informed; relationship to substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Opinion accompanying the search report commenting on patentability and other issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how examiners should express patentability concerns, indicators for novelty/inventive step and how the opinion is phrased.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the Division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions that must be satisfied prior to initiating substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checks such as payment of fees, request for examination, translations and correction of formal defects before substantive work proceeds.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive assessment of an application when first examined by the Examining Division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure for assessing claims, description and drawings against patentability criteria and for issuing first communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How to examine applicant responses and continue prosecution to resolve outstanding issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for admissibility of amendments, evaluation of arguments, iterative communications, and when to hold oral proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for concluding examination and making a decision on grant or refusal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers final checks, formality of claims, grant procedure, reasons for refusal and documentation to be issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex: Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the Divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard markup/notations to indicate amendments or corrections made by EPO Divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides concrete examples of marks and how amended text should be presented in communicated documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on procedural time limits and mechanisms for accelerating examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes statutory time limits, requests for accelerated processing, if/when fees apply and restoration options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous procedural matters arising during substantive examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include remittal, referral to Enlarged Board, interlocutory procedures and how to handle irregular situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and internal procedures specific to Examining Divisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allocation of tasks between examiners and rapporteurs, decision‑making practices and coordination of multi‑member divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling of non‑standard applications (e.g., biological sequences, software, plant varieties, medicines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes and special routes/procedures applicable to particular technical fields or exceptional case types.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks (Opposition and Limitation/Revocation Procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory principles for opposition, limitation and revocation procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains purpose, legal basis and parties' rights in opposition and post‑grant procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and responsibilities of the Opposition Division.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural rules for handling oppositions, decision‑making and internal organisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure and substantive criteria for filing and prosecuting an opposition against a granted European patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time limits, admissibility, grounds for opposition (e.g., Art. 100 EPC grounds), evidentiary standards and interaction with national proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (Opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stages and formal steps leading up to the substantive examination of an opposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes filing of notice of opposition, preliminary examination of admissibility and communications between parties and the Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: How the Opposition Division examines substantive grounds (novelty, inventive step, sufficiency, added subject‑matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and tests applied, use of prior art, claim construction, and how to assess requests for maintenance or revocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Step‑by‑step procedural conduct of opposition examination including evidence handling and oral proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance on exchange of submissions, hearings, admission of late‑filed documents and decisions drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Details and special features of the proceedings (Opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedural nuances and exceptional situations in opposition proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers complex cases, multiple opponents, confidentiality issues and cross‑jurisdictional complications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting and issuing opposition decisions, including form and content requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes required reasoning, operative part, and notification procedures for decisions to maintain, amend or revoke.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (Opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on allocation of costs in opposition proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How costs are awarded, which costs are reimbursable and factors influencing cost decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for centrally limiting or revoking a European patent at the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains voluntary limitation requests, legal effects, admissibility and formal requirements for revocation/limitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and methods for serving communications and notifications in EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes deemed receipt rules, postal vs electronic communications, and consequences of failures in notification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing oral proceedings before EPO bodies (Examining Division, Opposition Division, Boards of Appeal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissibility, requests by parties, language, conduct of hearings and consequences of non‑attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for presenting, admitting and preserving evidence in EPO proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on evidence types, burdens of proof, procedural timing for submitting evidence and conservation of records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which language derogations are permitted for oral proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural rules for interpretation, consent requirements and how language issues are handled at hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO may act of its own motion and handle late submissions and third‑party observations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for admitting late evidence, when the office can raise issues ex officio and treatment of third‑party submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption and stay of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how proceedings may be interrupted or stayed (e.g., pending national proceedings, PCT steps).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions for stay, procedural consequences and steps for resumption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re‑establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive rules on time limits, consequences of missing them, acceleration options and restoring rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes legal time limits, priority restoration, re‑establishment procedures and rules for accelerated/fast‑track processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: How PCT applications are treated within the European procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conversion rules, timetables, effect of international searches/reports and national phase entry mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (procedural)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural aspects and formal requirements of EPO decisions across different proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Drafting standards, notification, reasons and operative parts for procedural decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules governing appeals to the Boards of Appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissibility, grounds, time limits, procedural steps and interaction with first‑instance decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for providing technical opinions at the request of national courts regarding European patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formalities, scope of opinions, confidentiality and cooperation between EPO and national courts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registering transfers, licences, other rights, etc.; Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and evidentiary standards to register assignments, licences and other changes in the EPO Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentary requirements, effect of registrations and rectification steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description and other parts of an application apart from claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for structure, completeness, sequence listings, embodiments, examples and how the description must support claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific checklist items to evaluate the abstract of an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annex‑style checklist to ensure the abstract meets formal requirements, summarizes disclosure and complies with length/format rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted measurement units and standards for complying with Rule 49(10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists recognised units and guidance for their consistent use in applications and translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement and test that the application disclose the invention sufficiently for a skilled person to carry it out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benchmarks for adequacy of disclosure, examples of insufficient disclosure, and interplay with claim scope and post‑filed data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for clarity, support by the description and formal features of claims per Art. 84 EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria for claim drafting, clarity tests, allowable claim formats, dependency chains and common formal objections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples showing how to identify and treat essential features in claims and description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides example claim formulations and analyses demonstrating what will be considered essential vs. non‑essential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and tests for unity of invention as applied to the content of the application (claims and description).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains legal criteria to determine whether claims form a single inventive concept and how to handle multiple inventions (divisional, partial search).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing priority claims, priority dates and proof of priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural steps for claiming priority, deadlines, required documents and effects of priority on novelty/inventive step assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall criteria and approach to decide whether subject‑matter is patentable under the EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High‑level framework covering exclusions, technical character and interplay of novelty, inventive step and industrial application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of 'invention' under the EPC and what qualifies as technical subject‑matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on distinguishing patentable inventions from non‑inventions (e.g., discoveries, mathematical methods, business methods) and tests for technical character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that an invention be capable of industrial application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tests and examples showing how to assess industrial applicability and sufficiency of practical use disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and determination of the state of the art for novelty and inventive step purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes what counts as prior art, effective dates, and treatment of different types of disclosures and documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on disclosures that do not prejudice novelty (e.g., grace periods, non‑prejudicial disclosures under specific conditions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Circumstances and requirements for treating certain disclosures as non‑prejudicial and how to evidence and apply such exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: The legal test and assessment for novelty of claimed subject‑matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to compare claims to prior art, what constitutes a single disclosure, and examples of novelty‑destroying disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and approach to assess inventive step (non‑obviousness) of claimed subject‑matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stepwise problem‑solution approach, indicators of inventive step, examples (annex) and common pitfalls in reasoning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex: Examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete examples and indicators illustrating the inventive step analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Worked examples to demonstrate application of the problem‑solution approach and evidentiary indicators supporting inventive step conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal and procedural framework governing when and how applications and patents may be amended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timing, admissibility, form and restrictions on amendments during prosecution and post‑grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General admissibility criteria that any amendment must satisfy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards such as clarity, support in the application as filed, scope changes and procedural requirements for filing amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural issues and exceptions related to admission of amendments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes late‑filed amendments, amendments in appeal/opposition, and criteria for admitting or refusing them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(2) and Art. 123(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for assessing added subject‑matter (Art. 123(2)) and extension of protection after grant (Art. 123(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tests for added matter, examples of unallowable amendments, and constraints on post‑grant claim widening.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples applying Art. 123(2)/(3) and amendment allowability tests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete case examples showing permissible and impermissible amendment scenarios to guide examiners and practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting mistakes in the application or granted patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between obvious errors, clerical mistakes and substantive corrections; sets out formalities and limits on corrections.
